name: Belief tag v1 (tag new + changed beliefs)
notes: Daily at 05:35 local, after the feedback_extractor drain (04:00-05:00). Tags active intake beliefs (belief_intake_beliefs) that are untagged OR revised since tagged, from the standardized vocab (configs/belief_tags.yaml), then rewrites the belief export so the extractor's and the day's work-outcome changes reach its readers. The intake (01:00) does the same after its own run; this pass covers writes after it. 'needs' selector + max_per_run cap + max_run_seconds watchdog.
